title: Claude Code Stopped Assuming GitHub
caption:
I've been on GitHub so long I forgot Claude Code was built assuming it.

Two releases, Aug 13 and 14: GitLab merge requests in --worktree, nine token prefixes redacted, plugin marketplaces cloning straight from gitlab.com. The GitHub-app setup tip even goes quiet when your remote is GitLab or Bitbucket.

Honestly? I assumed first-class GitLab support was never coming.

Where does your code live?

slides.headline:
Claude Code stopped
assuming GitHub
slides.sub: Versions 2.1.232 and 2.1.233, shipped Aug 13-14: GitLab gets the treatment GitHub already had.

slides.title: Merge requests, natively
slides.sub: The --worktree flag and the claude agents view now take GitLab MR URLs. MRs display as !N.

slides.title: Then the plumbing
items: Nine GitLab token families now redacted, with glpat- and gldt- fully masked
The glab CLI config store gets the same sandbox protection gh already had
Plugin marketplaces clone bare gitlab.com URLs, nested subgroups included

slides.headline: Moving off GitHub?
slides.sub: and I'll send the changelog + the token list
